# Did this PR drop your coverage?

> Paste two Cobertura or JaCoCo coverage XML reports — baseline vs this PR — and see whether line coverage dropped, and which files got worse. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded. A floor like --cov-fail-under=80 misses a drop from 92% to 81%.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
